title: Add webapp template: server package.json
description: Create the server package.json template for the Express backend. Lists Express v5, better-sqlite3, jsonwebtoken, bcryptjs, nodemailer, and zod as runtime dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: tsx and vitest are in devDependencies

steps.details: Create src/templates/webapp/server/package.json.tmpl with name '{{PROJECT_NAME}}-server', version '0.0.1', type 'module'. Runtime dependencies: express, better-sqlite3, jsonwebtoken, bcryptjs, nodemailer, zod, cors. DevDependencies: tsx, typescript, vitest, @types/express, @types/better-sqlite3, @types/jsonwebtoken, @types/bcryptjs, @types/nodemailer, @types/cors.
Add scripts: { 'dev': 'tsx watch src/index.ts', 'build': 'tsc -p tsconfig.json', 'start': 'node dist/index.js', 'test': 'vitest run' }

steps.description: Verify all server dependencies are listed
steps.details: Review the template and confirm all packages from the PRD Section 5.1 Type A server stack are present.

technicalNotes: better-sqlite3 is a native addon — it requires a rebuild when the Node.js version changes. This is why the template pins it rather than a peer dep
bcryptjs (pure JS) is used instead of bcrypt (native) to avoid native compilation issues
